ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity (white) localized patches; approximate distribution 80% low-intensity to 20% high-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) mottling patches concentrated on the distal regions (outer tips) of both lobes; centralized region around the peduncle and median notch is predominantly low-intensity (black).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge; sharp, irregular peaks and valleys of varying pixel amplitudes (3-10 pixels) visible from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve originating from the median notch, flattening slightly towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast circular clusters (barnacle colonies) located on the superior-most points of the distal tips of both lobes; scattered smaller white circular scars across the low-intensity surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, likely rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the tips of both lobes; multiple depigmented circular scars (rosettes) scattered across the black ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant symmetrical high-contrast white mottling patterns on the distal edges of both lobes.
